payload.evidence: Scheduled ChatGPT automations do not own Tower byte writes. Persist proposals with read-back; the sole unattended Tower writer is byDenoso/Pantheon GitHub Actions workflow 'NEXO Writer robot', using the canonical writer, CAS and read-back. Guardiao audits and enqueues repairs but never writes Tower bytes.

semantic.question_plain: Quem deve escrever a Tower quando as automações agendadas não conseguem concluir a escrita?
semantic.result_meaning: A escrita durável da Tower fica centralizada no Writer robot do GitHub Actions; tarefas agendadas apenas produzem propostas.
semantic.practical_decision: Usar inbox -> GitHub Actions Writer -> CAS/read-back -> tower-head/ATLAS.
